note: Placeholders in {braces} are filled from survey.json and real_world_data.json at runtime. [data], [opinion] and [assumption] mark the tag colour.

events.title: "Data centres are eating Ireland's power"
events.body: Ireland is ten years ahead of Bournemouth on data centres. Guess first: by 2025, what share of Ireland's electricity did data centres use?
events.reveal:
[data]DATA[/data]  CSO: data centres used {share_2015}% of Ireland's metered electricity in 2015 and {share_2025}% in 2025 ({gwh_2025} GWh).

[opinion]OPINION[/opinion]  {significant_true}% of surveyed respondents in Ireland believed data centres use a 'significant proportion' of the country's electricity.

Bournemouth's compute demand will now grow along Ireland's real curve, about {growth_2034}x by 2034. Meet it without losing the town.

events.title: "Server farms run on coal and gas"
events.body: True or false: all data centres in Ireland run on fossil fuels.
events.reveal:
[opinion]OPINION[/opinion]  {fossil_true}% of surveyed respondents in Ireland answered True.

[data]DATA[/data]  EirGrid: renewables met {renew_2015}% of Ireland's electricity demand in 2015 and {renew_2025}% in 2025. Grid-connected data centres draw that mix, so 'all fossil' is not supported, though most of the rest is still fossil.

Data is not opinion: many people believing something doesn't make it true.

events.title: What would win your neighbours over?
events.body: Survey respondents each picked the three conditions that would most raise their acceptance of a data centre. Which was picked most often?
events.reveal:
[opinion]OPINION[/opinion]  Top-3 picks among {top3_n} respondents: waste heat {pct_waste_heat}%, renewable power {pct_renewable}%, local jobs {pct_local_jobs}%, community fund {pct_community_fund}%.

[assumption]ASSUMPTION[/assumption]  In this game each upgrade wins over that same share of a data centre's objectors. Click one of your data centres to buy upgrades.

events.title: Follow Ireland's new rule?
events.body: Irish media report tighter rules: new data centres must supply more of their own renewable energy and ease the strain on the grid. Adopt the same rule for Bournemouth?
options: Adopt: new centres include a renewable deal (+25% cost)
events.reveal:
[data]SOURCE[/data]  Supplied media review of RTÉ and Irish Times coverage.

[assumption]ASSUMPTION[/assumption]  Rejecting the rule costs 4 acceptance points in the local press; adopting it adds a renewable deal to every new centre.

events.title: Who gets the power first?
events.body: When electricity runs short, which sector did the most people say should get power first?
events.reveal:
[opinion]OPINION[/opinion]  Beyond Fossil Fuels survey (2025), top priority: healthcare {prio_health}%, agriculture and food {prio_food}%, housing {prio_housing}%, data centres {prio_dc}%.

In this game, data centres are throttled first when the grid runs short. Throttled centres earn less and serve less demand.
